llm_summary: This diff corresponds to the well-documented November 2021 coa npm package hijack (2.0.2 → 2.0.3). A new 'preinstall' hook was added that executes compile.js, which in turn spawned compile.bat — an obfuscated Windows batch script that downloaded and executed the DanaBot password-stealing trojan from an external domain via curl/wget/certutil. The actual malicious code is not present in this specific diff (replaced with researcher placeholder comments), but the structural evidence — new preinstall hook, new compile.bat, new compile.js, native addon flag — matches the verified attack pattern with high confidence. This is a definitive supply chain compromise.
